correctness.rationale: For the 12-vertex icosahedral graph, independent exact enumeration confirms 285 disconnected induced foursets, 3502 nonempty cut faces, and an acyclic 1738-pair matching with one critical vertex, six critical dimension-six cells and 21 dimension-seven cells; all 19,524 directed Hasse incidences were traversed. Signed Morse boundary has a single primitive rank-one column and integral Smith invariants (1). Since pi6(vee^6 S6)=Z6, one degree-one pair cancels, leaving wedge^5 S6 wedge^20 S7. The complex is pure dimension7 with nonzero H6, proving nonshellability; the 12 missing six-vertex faces are complements of closed neighborhoods.
